comingLast.roast: a high marker holding the blue balls - the honour board salutes the effort
4 points from escape - Bradley has stopped watching his own card
at 1.2 a hole he is on track for the full ceremony
5 holes of runway left - 4 points clears the fence
on 20 - the only man on the course playing match play against the bottom of the list
1 from his last 4 - grandstand finish at the wrong end
in the clubhouse 1 clear - his card is safe, his pride pending
1 clear of the worst seat in the house
2 points is all that separates him from a very blue evening
3 above Bradley from the clubhouse - it never felt so thin from a chair
